summary: Backend testing for Study Matrai complete. 15/15 tests passed (100%). All endpoints work end-to-end with Gemini 3 Flash via Emergent LLM key: /api/explain (topic-only and text-only), /api/summarize (text), /api/quiz (3 MCQs with 4 options + correct_index 0-3 + explanation), /api/flashcards (>=4 {front, back} cards), /api/history (GET returns items, no _id leakage), /api/history/{id} (DELETE returns deleted count; verified persistence removal). Validation correctly returns 400 for empty payloads on explain/summarize/quiz/flashcards. Multimodal verified: explain with image_base64 (1x1 PNG) and summarize with pdf_base64 (tiny inline PDF) both return 200 with content. No _id leaked from MongoDB in any response. Average end-to-end latency for AI calls ~1-3s.

minor.issue: Always returns 200 even when nothing was deleted (deleted=0). Consider returning 404 for missing ids to be more RESTful, but current behavior matches contract.
Exception detail (raw 'AI error: ...') is exposed in 500 responses; consider sanitizing for production.

action_items: No backend action required. Frontend testing was explicitly skipped per request.
Optional: return 404 from DELETE /api/history/{id} when no matching record exists (currently returns {deleted: 0} with 200).
Optional: sanitize 500 error detail to avoid leaking internal exception messages to clients.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~355-line file — acceptable size, no split needed yet.

MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection in /api/history and never inserted into the returned dict elsewhere (uses record.copy() prior to insert_one which mutates with _id only on the inserted doc).
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, MONGO_URL and DB_NAME are read from .env via load_dotenv — no hardcoding.
Pydantic models used for request validation; QuizItem/Flashcard validated per item with type checks (4 options, 0<=correct_index<=3).
_extract_json fallback handles markdown fences and extracts JSON via regex — robust.
Temp files for image/pdf are cleaned up in a finally block in _ask_gemini.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient history items (explain/summarize/quiz/flashcards) and clean them up at the end of the run via DELETE /api/history/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://quick-study-ai-11.preview.emergentagent.com. Tests located at /app/backend/tests/test_study_matrai.py. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Multimodal helpers build minimal PNG/PDF base64 inline in the test file. Gemini 3 Flash is reachable via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY configured in /app/backend/.env. All 15 tests pass.
